answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization focuses on generating fluent and concise text from the original input document...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate summarization performance, we use the ROUGE metrics (R-1, R-2 and R-L) (Lin, 2004).

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation on the two aspects of readability and non-redundancy... Three annotators are asked to rank each set of three summaries with respect to readability and non-redundancy.
answer_4.guideline: Three annotators are asked to rank each set of three summaries with respect to readability and non-redundancy. The best is ranked the first while the worst is the third, and the ranks are allowed to be tied.
